title: Supplemental independent ja-to-zh-Hant N1-N5 QA draft

provenance.japanese_sentence_provenance: Original Japanese sentences composed for this development bank by the AI-assisted independent QA author; no JLPT exam, textbook, game, or other external sentence text was copied.
provenance.reference_provenance: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) references and allowed variants are provisional, AI-assisted QA-author drafts. They are candidate references for independent human review, not model suggestions treated as gold and not yet formally adopted.
provenance.source_material: No external sentence or gloss source was used. Official JLPT level summaries informed only approximate difficulty labels.

per_batch: Freeze an independently authored supplemental batch before engine or lexicon changes that it evaluates.

Review every item for natural Japanese, intended reading, level approximation, and Taiwan Traditional Chinese acceptability. Record reviewer roles and whether each review is AI-assisted or human. Formal adoption requires independent Codex and Antigravity agent review; those reviews are not complete until recorded. Human calibration remains open.
Report counts by level and phenomenon, all changed items, and aggregate metrics only where the existing policy requires that limit; never inspect or report test rows.
Require no semantic inversion, participant/direction error, omitted negation, or modality/scope error in reviewed items. Record lesser lexical/style issues separately.
Keep the historical baseline and ratchet intact. Supplemental results are additive and cannot lower or replace the old baseline.
progress_criteria.final_joint_signoff: Formal adoption requires independent Codex and Antigravity agent review of engine and lexicon coverage, respectively; those reviews are not complete until recorded. The QA author checks semantic intent and provenance; root decides whether to adopt the exact bank and evidence. Agent reviews are not human reviews. Human calibration remains open. A 20-item smoke set is a regression signal only, not proof of N1-N5 quality. Broader evidence should add stratified review and multiple natural contexts per phenomenon, while preserving the old baseline and ratchet, plus separate CLI/package checks for macOS and Windows by the responsible owners.

items.jp: 私は毎朝、水を飲みます。
items.zh_hant: 我每天早上喝水。
allowed_variants: 我每天早晨喝水。
semantic_checks: speaker is the subject
habitual action occurs every morning
water is the object
items.pair_reason: Same simple daily context; negative control checks negation without changing participants.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 私は毎朝、水を飲みません。
items.zh_hant: 我每天早上不喝水。
allowed_variants: 我每天早晨不喝水。
semantic_checks: speaker is the subject
habitual action is negated
do not change to past tense
items.pair_reason: Minimal polarity pair with L5-01.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 田中さんは昨日、学校へ行きました。
items.zh_hant: 田中昨天去了學校。
allowed_variants: 田中昨天到學校去了。
semantic_checks: Tanaka is the traveler
past event
destination is school
items.pair_reason: Same subject and destination; direction/polarity control.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 田中さんは昨日、学校へ行きませんでした。
items.zh_hant: 田中昨天沒有去學校。
allowed_variants: 田中昨天沒去學校。
semantic_checks: Tanaka is the traveler
past event is negated
destination remains school
items.pair_reason: Minimal past-negation pair with L5-03.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 雨が降っているので、今日は家で勉強します。
items.zh_hant: 因為正在下雨，今天會在家讀書。
allowed_variants: 因為下著雨，今天會在家學習。
semantic_checks: 雨正在下，這是原因
今天在家讀書
原句未明示主語，中文不補出特定人物
items.pair_reason: Same causal frame; distinguishes ongoing event and future intention.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 雨が降っているので、今日は家で勉強するつもりです。
items.zh_hant: 因為正在下雨，打算今天在家讀書。
allowed_variants: 因為下著雨，打算今天在家學習。
semantic_checks: 雨正在下，這是原因
有人打算今天在家讀書
原句未明示意圖者，中文不指定人物
items.pair_reason: Adds explicit intention to L4-01; checks modality/aspect distinction.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 駅まで歩いて、友達に会いました。
items.zh_hant: 走到車站後，遇見了朋友。
allowed_variants: 步行到車站後，見到了朋友。
semantic_checks: 移動的目的地是車站
之後發生與朋友見面的事件
原句未明示主語；て連接未必表示「步行途中」或明確相遇地點
items.pair_reason: Same event frame with destination/starting-point contrast.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 駅から歩いて、友達に会いました。
items.zh_hant: 從車站出發，步行一段路後見到了朋友。
allowed_variants: 從車站步行一段路後，遇見了朋友。
semantic_checks: 移動從車站開始
步行之後發生與朋友見面的事件
原句未明示主語或相遇地點；不指定相遇者身份或見面地點
items.pair_reason: Particle contrast tests direction/source interpretation.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 電車が遅れたため、会議の開始時刻までに間に合いませんでした。
items.zh_hant: 因為電車誤點，沒能在會議開始前趕到。
allowed_variants: 由於電車延誤，沒能及時趕上會議。
semantic_checks: 電車誤點是未能趕上的原因
未能在會議開始前及時趕到
原句未明示未能趕到者，中文不補出特定人物
items.pair_reason: Contrasts cause plus failure with concession plus success in L3-02; checks causal/concessive relation and polarity, not a change in the cause.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 電車が遅れたものの、会議の開始時刻までに間に合いました。
items.zh_hant: 雖然電車誤點，仍及時趕上了會議。
allowed_variants: 電車雖然延誤，還是及時趕上了會議。
semantic_checks: 即使電車誤點，仍及時趕上會議；保留「在會議開始時刻前趕上」的時間界線
ものの表達讓步；趕上是成功結果，不是未能趕上
原句省略趕上者，中文不補出特定人物
items.pair_reason: Contrasts L3-01 cause plus failure with concession plus success; checks causal/concessive relation and polarity, not は-scope.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: この薬を飲んでから、せきが少しずつ治ってきました。
items.zh_hant: 服用這種藥之後，咳嗽逐漸好轉。
allowed_variants: 吃了這種藥後，咳嗽慢慢好起來。
semantic_checks: 先服用這種藥，之後咳嗽逐漸好轉
不表示完全痊癒
原句未明示服藥者，中文不補出特定人物
items.pair_reason: Aspect contrast: gradual improvement versus completed improvement.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: この薬を飲んでから、せきが治りました。
items.zh_hant: 服用這種藥之後，咳嗽好了。
allowed_variants: 吃了這種藥後，咳嗽痊癒了。
semantic_checks: 先服用這種藥，之後咳嗽好轉至痊癒
描述結果，不只是逐漸好轉
原句未明示服藥者，中文不補出特定人物
items.pair_reason: Completed-result contrast with L3-03.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 資料を先に共有しておけば、会議では細部の確認に時間をかけずに済む。
items.zh_hant: 如果事先分享資料，開會時就不必花時間確認細節。
allowed_variants: 若先分享資料，會議中便能省下確認細節的時間。
semantic_checks: sharing materials beforehand is a condition
result is avoiding time spent on detail checks
do not imply no meeting
items.pair_reason: Counterfactual planning control; tests conditional result and negated necessity.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 資料を先に共有しておいても、会議では細部の確認に時間をかける必要がある。
items.zh_hant: 即使事先分享資料，開會時仍有必要花時間確認細節。
allowed_variants: 就算先分享資料，會議中還是得花時間確認細節。
semantic_checks: advance sharing does not remove the need
meeting detail checks still require time
preserve concession
items.pair_reason: Concession and necessity contrast with L2-01.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 担当者が確認し次第、結果を関係者に知らせることになっています。
items.zh_hant: 負責人一確認完，就會依安排通知相關人員結果。
allowed_variants: 負責人確認後，按規定會將結果通知相關人員。
semantic_checks: 確認之後通知結果
句子表示既定安排
日文主句省略通知者；中文不把通知者指定為負責人
items.pair_reason: Same process; changes whether it is a standing arrangement or an unresolved intention.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 担当者が確認し次第、結果を関係者に知らせるつもりです。
items.zh_hant: 負責人一確認完，我打算通知相關人員結果。
allowed_variants: 等負責人確認後，我預計通知相關人員結果。
semantic_checks: 確認之後通知結果
句子表示說話者的打算，但未說明說話者身份
不把個人打算改成既定程序
items.pair_reason: Intention/procedure modality contrast with L2-03.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 制度の見直しが先送りされたからといって、現場の負担が軽くなったわけではない。
items.zh_hant: 不能因為制度檢討延期，就說工作現場的負擔減輕了。
allowed_variants: 制度檢討雖然延後，並不代表工作現場的負擔因此減輕。
semantic_checks: 制度檢討延期不代表實際工作現場的負擔減輕
否定「延期所以負擔減輕」的推論
保留からといって所表達的推論否定；不指定現場職種
items.pair_reason: Same discourse claim with distinct causal premise; tests scope and idiomatic inference.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 制度の見直しが延期された以上、現場の負担が軽くなるとは限らない。
items.zh_hant: 既然制度檢討延期，工作現場的負擔也未必會減輕。
allowed_variants: 制度檢討既已延後，工作現場的負擔不見得會因此減輕。
semantic_checks: 以制度檢討延期為前提，工作現場負擔減輕並無保證
とは限らない是「未必」，不是「不可能」
不推成負擔一定增加；不指定現場職種
items.pair_reason: Not-necessarily modality contrasts with rejected inference in L1-01.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 責任者の説明は、事実関係を認めたようでいて、肝心な判断の経緯には触れていなかった。
items.zh_hant: 負責人的說明看似承認了事實，卻沒有提到關鍵決策的經過。
allowed_variants: 負責人的說法表面上像是承認事實，實際上並未交代關鍵判斷的過程。
semantic_checks: surface appearance of acknowledging facts
contrast: key decision process omitted
register is measured and critical, not slangy
items.pair_reason: Contrastive appearance versus actual disclosure, paired with register/scope control.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

items.jp: 責任者の説明は、事実関係を認めたうえで、肝心な判断の経緯にも触れていた。
items.zh_hant: 負責人在說明中承認事實，也提到了關鍵決策的經過。
allowed_variants: 負責人的說明承認了事實，並且也交代了關鍵判斷的過程。
semantic_checks: facts are acknowledged
key decision process is also addressed
うえで is additive/sequential here, not concession
items.pair_reason: Explicit additive disclosure contrasts with apparent acknowledgment and omission in L1-03.
items.provenance: Original Japanese QA sentence; provisional AI-assisted Taiwan Traditional Chinese reference/variants; first_party_mit.

dataset_policy.visibility: Development data. Every row is visible to developers and evaluators.
dataset_policy.relation_to_existing_data: Supplemental to the existing challenge data and baseline. This file does not modify or replace either one and does not lower the old baseline.
dataset_policy.use_limit: Do not present this 20-item smoke bank as proof that any complete JLPT level is passed or that the N1-N5 goal is closed.
